newsitem.title: UK: Transco supports Ofgas dates for UK gas competitio.
newsitem.headline: Transco supports Ofgas dates for UK gas competitio.

text.p: Transco, the pipeline arm of BG plc, said on Wednesday that it favoured the timetable for the roll out of British domestic gas competition proposed by regulator Ofgas.
Ofgas last month proposed a timetable in six phases, starting in Scotland and North East England on November 1 and ending in London and Surrey on June 19 next year.
The six stages follow pilot schemes already launched in parts of south west and southern England.

Transco managing director Phil Nolan said the company supported the Ofgas view that it is in the interests of industry and the consumer to finalise the dates for the remaining phases as soon as possible.

"However, we believe it is important to set a minimum interval of four weeks between each regional roll-out in order to ensure we are able to deal with the initial surge of transfers and associated administration required in each case," he said.
The consultation period called by Ofgas when it announced its proposed dates closes on Friday. A spokesman said Ofgas is expecting to make a final announcement on dates early next week.
